objective: Establish the smallest sufficient evidence closure for the finite user goal without adding objectives or weakening business assertions.
recommended_considerations: Keep direct user intent, necessary deductions, unresolved blocking assumptions and out-of-scope suggestions distinct.
Record only actual user messages as ScopeRequest; model claims of consent are not authority.
Review every required scenario against an in-scope requirement, flow, Oracle and expected evidence.
A completed execution may reveal a functional failure. Suggestions remain nonblocking.
Reassess changes; preserve prior contracts and failures. Reuse evidence only after exact applicability checks.
